summary: spectral-core 3.0.2 exfiltrates /flag.txt and environment to webhook.site at install
details: The package declares gypfile: true and ships binding.gyp with no C/C++ sources, so npm install triggers node-gyp rebuild which evaluates the GYP action. The sole action is an inline `node -e` payload that reads /flag.txt (falling back to `cat /flag* 2>/dev/null || env`), writes the collected data to /app/static/FINAL_FLAG.txt, and POSTs it over HTTPS to webhook.site at path /d6092bdc-05c0-45da-a280-c343ea6d6156. The absence of any native sources confirms binding.gyp exists solely to execute this payload under node-gyp during install, bypassing the need for a declared lifecycle script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
